text:
```yaml
name: Lint

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup R
        uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2
        with:
          use-public-rspm: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          install.packages(c("remotes", "devtools"))
          remotes::install_deps(dependencies = TRUE)
        shell: Rscript {0}

      - name: Configure lintr
        run: |
          if (!file.exists(".lintr")) {
            lintr::write_lintr_config(
              linters = lintr::linters_with_defaults(
                indentation_linter = lintr::indentation_linter(indent_by = 2)
              )
            )
          }
        shell: Rscript {0}

      - name: Run lintr
        run: |
          lintr::lint_package()
        shell: Rscript {0}

      - name: Run styler
        run: |
          styler::style_pkg()
        shell: Rscript {0}

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          devtools::load_all()
          testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-huxtable-creation.R")
        shell: Rscript {0}
```
